symptom: A 512 timestep late-win-conversion continuation from the e30 supervised SB3 re-alignment passed anchor validation guard and offline anchor alignment, improved 60s/180s windows, and restored cracked-star-jar 300s win rate to 0.3333, but soda-creek and caramel-workshop 300s win rates remained 0.0. The repair probe gate failed because caramel-workshop 180s dominant action ratio increased by 0.265 against the e30 baseline.
root_cause: The e30 checkpoint is a stable anchor-aligned initialization, but a small final-minute closed-loop continuation still shifts action distribution enough to trigger a mid-window caramel-workshop no-regression blocker while failing to solve soda-creek and caramel-workshop long-run conversion. The remaining 300s failures span opening, mid, and late windows, so the problem is not isolated to a late-only objective.
fix: Do not extend this exact configuration. Before another longer closed-loop run, add explicit no-regression protection for caramel-workshop 180s action distribution and keep full-anchor alignment plus 60/180/300 fixed-window checks as hard gates.
validation: train_sb3.py produced ppo_training_report.json with final anchor validation mean KL 0.109673 and argmax agreement 0.8224, passing the configured anchor validation guard. compare_sb3_to_behavior_clone_anchor.py accepted both anchor_drift_alignment.json and full_anchor_alignment.json. Fixed-window comparisons improved 60s/180s and cracked-star-jar 300s, but comparison_300s.json still reported multimap_comparison_recorded_needs_policy_repair. validate_policy_window_regression.py rejected the branch against e30 due to the caramel-workshop 180s dominant action ratio increase, and validate_rl_repair_probe_gate.py returned rl_repair_probe_gate_failed.
